content: On the other hand, service providers targeting the luxury and exotic car market must invest heavily in specialized equipment, premium customer service, and rigorous risk management frameworks to satisfy the exacting standards of private individuals. Ultimately, the South African automotive cargo sector requires a highly segmented approach, where transport providers must meticulously align their operational capabilities with the distinct requirements of the vehicle types they handle and the specific profiles of the clients they serve. The transition toward electric mobility, however, introduces complex operational challenges that require sophisticated transport configurations. A noted slowing in passenger electric vehicle adoption has directly impacted road transport battery demand, creating a fluctuating environment for logistics providers [54] . Competitors in the vehicle transport sector must therefore maintain highly agile operational strategies, balancing the established requirements of internal combustion engine vehicle logistics with the specialized handling, weight distribution, and safety protocols necessitated by electric vehicles and their heavy battery components [54] . Furthermore, safety advancements remain a critical pillar of operational expertise within this sector. Priorities in technological collaboration and safety advancements, such as those emphasized at the Enhanced Safety of Vehicles International Conference, underscore the industry's commitment to mitigating risks associated with modern vehicle transportation [52] .
